message: Initial scaffold population: stack locked (Go/Echo, modernc.org/sqlite, goldmark, argon2id, TS+esbuild plugin); deployment is flexible (Cloudflare Tunnel OR direct droplet — tunnel-only assumption dropped per owner); 5 PRD open questions recorded as pending decisions in context/decisions.md

MVP Go server implemented in server/ (module obsidian-publish/server): Echo v4, pure-Go SQLite (modernc), goldmark render-at-publish, argon2id (t=1,m=64MB,p=4, PHC format), route-scoped HMAC session cookie (1h, resolves PRD open question 14.4), bearer-token /api plane with constant-time compare, 5/min per IP+route sliding-window rate limit, slug validation + reserved routes, user_version schema pin. PUT password semantics agreed with plugin agent: omitted=keep, JSON null or empty string=remove, non-empty=set. Theme endpoint intentionally skipped (v2). build/vet/test all pass; CGO_ENABLED=0 verified.

MVP complete on main: server (19f6b8c) and plugin (96955cd) merged; verified independently (go build/vet/test, npm build + 37/37 vitest) and full e2e smoke passed (401 gate, publish, password gate incl. form-only pre-auth + cookie unlock, list without hash exposure, delete->404)

Plugin theme settings + image publishing: image embeds are rewritten to server asset URLs in the OUTBOUND publish payload only; the note file on disk is never modified (deliberate product decision — publishing must not mutate the vault). Upload failures fail soft (publish continues, embed left unrewritten, warning Notice). Asset uploads dedupe per vault file path, not raw embed target.

Round 2 complete on main: theming (global + per-page override), image asset publishing (upload+outbound rewrite, vault never mutated), and deployment tooling (systemd/Docker/tunnel/droplet docs) merged; all four remaining PRD open questions resolved in decisions.md; combined e2e re-verified (theme precedence, unthemed password form, asset dedupe/svg-rejection/immutable-cache/traversal-404, theme reset). Known gap noted: HEAD /assets returns 405.

Settings password management shipped (0.0.2): per-row generate/replace password via password-only PUT, shared show-once ShowPasswordModal (replaces the old 15s plaintext Notice), ribbon + settings publish button. Owner decision: show-once model, no plaintext persistence. Live-verified: rotation invalidates old pw immediately, public page can be gated from settings.

Bugfix 0.0.3: stale note-route mapping made republish-after-unpublish open update mode and 404. Root cause: modal trusted the local convenience map. Fix: openPublishModal verifies route availability against the server and forgets stale entries; submit() falls back to create on not-found. Regression tests added (4, main.test.ts). Owner hit this live.

Release 0.0.4: added Unpublish this note command (palette + editor context menu, gated on local route record). Server-verified before delete: free route drops stale mapping, 404 cleans up, other failures keep mapping. 5 new vitest tests (107 total). Tagged 0.0.4, GitHub release v0.0.4 with main.js/manifest.json/styles.css.

Bugfix: unpublish showed 'could not reach the server (Unexpected end of JSON input)' though the delete succeeded. Root cause: DELETE returned 204 with empty body; Obsidian requestUrl JSON-parses every response body and throws on empty ones; mapError mapped the throw to unreachable. Fix: server DELETE now returns 200 + {"deleted": route} (contract updated); plugin stays 204-tolerant at its own layer. Server redeploy required; plugin 0.0.4 needs no change. This also explains how the 0.0.3 stale-mapping bug arose live: settings unpublish hit the same misleading error while the delete went through.
